block_1_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
block_1_metadata.role: OmniCode Cognitive Continuum: Dual-Domain (Local & Cloud) Verification Window Across the 7 Qwen 2.5 / Coder Sizes
block_1_metadata.scaffold_notice: Temporary open-weights substrate powered by the official Qwen 2.5 family (0.5B to 72B, Coder & Reasoning) on the OmniCode Cognitive Chassis. Proprietary MillenniumOS native weights in active development.
invariants: 2. Config file acts as a verification window [min_floor, max_ceiling] for empirically probed ideal states.
3. Universal Law: Local First -> Cloud (If Able) applied uniformly across all tiers.
4. The second cloud operational space matches local capacity (<= 7B on this host), the system auto-triggers Local Mode.
5. Cloud compute maintains dynamic min/ideal/max envelopes per tier, adapting compute to task demand.
6. On current host, 14B, 32B, and 72B evaluate local_supported=false and route to Cloud (If Able).
7. The absolute bedrock floor is 0.5B Min. If 0.5B Min fails, tripwire engages Level 0 Safe-Mode BIOS.

block_2_opening.pre_conditions: Empirical hardware probe calibrates ideal configuration inside the bounded verification window

spectrum_architecture.official_series: Qwen 2.5 Ecosystem (Coder: 0.5B-32B, Dense Flagship: 72B, Reasoning: QwQ)

sovereignty_contract.auto_local_trigger_rule: When task demand <= sovereign_local_ceiling and local_chassis_ready == true, execution_target MUST switch to LOCAL immediately to eliminate network latency, external dependencies, and token burn.
sovereignty_contract.cloud_elevation_rule: When task demand > sovereign_local_ceiling or local RAM/VRAM saturation > 92%, execution_target elevates to CLOUD (If Able).

cloud_strategy.rationale: Cloud compute removes local VRAM bottlenecks. The cloud adapts dynamically: using 14B for fast refactoring, 32B for flagship code authoring, and 72B/QwQ for strategic architecture and proofs. The moment task demand drops to <= 7B, the system auto-triggers Local Mode.
